title: Can’t start, won’t start: Over 150 new military programs face delay under a CR
summary: The Defense Department will be operating under a continuing resolution until lawmakers successfully pass a fiscal 2027 budget.
author: Michael Marrow, Ashley Roque, Diana Stancy, Carley Welch, Theresa Hitchens and Valerie Insinna
